hints.title: Pairwise Distances via BFS
hints.text: Compute structured search distances d(a, b), d(b, c), and d(a, c) using breadth-first search.

hints.title: Positive Length Filter
hints.text: Ensure all three pairwise distances are strictly positive.

hints.title: Pythagorean Equation Verification
hints.text: Sort the three distances in ascending order [x, y, z] and verify if x^2 + y^2 == z^2.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
